Compare current observations with historical and domain context

title: Ad Service — High CPU
description: The ad service shows a substantial CPU increase in the incident window.
investigation_focus: Compare CPU measurements across baseline and incident windows
Inspect log patterns, trace summaries, and Kubernetes state

title: Checkout → Payment · Dependency Unavailable
description: Checkout records UNAVAILABLE responses on outbound Payment Charge requests, with errors observed in related Checkout operations.
investigation_focus: Inspect the outbound Checkout-to-Payment Charge status and related Checkout operation errors
Compare client-side and server-side observations without assuming unobserved Payment behavior

title: Messaging Failure
description: A prepared messaging exercise records a queue-overload simulation and a consumer-side delay alongside producer and consumer telemetry.
symptoms: Measured consumer lag remains at zero
investigation_focus: Compare the captured queue-overload and consumer-delay records with producer and consumer signals
Account for the zero measured consumer-lag values rather than assuming a lag spike
Separate the intended simulation from what the telemetry independently establishes
